% Pattern: number/counter. The begin code of an environment,
% \setcounter{item}{\value{equation}}\addtocounter{equation}{1}, numbers the
% items with the equations, and an environment that is not an item steps the
% equations too, so the lemmas are 1.2 and 1.5. Seen in the gold pilot
% (set X).
% want lem-1 statement/lemma 1.2
% want lem-2 statement/lemma 1.5
\documentclass{article}
\numberwithin{equation}{section}
\newcounter{item}
\renewcommand{\theitem}{\arabic{section}.\arabic{item}}
\newenvironment{lem}{\setcounter{item}{\value{equation}}\addtocounter{equation}{1}
\refstepcounter{item}\par{\bf \theitem.\ Lemma.} }{\par}
\newenvironment{aside}{\addtocounter{equation}{1}\par}{\par}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{equation} a = b \end{equation}
\begin{lem} Every finite space is compact. \end{lem}
\begin{aside} A note on the spaces. \end{aside}
\begin{equation} c = d \end{equation}
\begin{lem} Every point is closed. \end{lem}
\end{document}
